SELECT c.column_name, c.full_data_type, c.is_nullable,
       c.table_catalog, c.table_schema, c.table_name,
       t.table_type
FROM `{catalog}`.information_schema.columns c
JOIN `{catalog}`.information_schema.tables t
  ON t.table_catalog = c.table_catalog
 AND t.table_schema = c.table_schema
 AND t.table_name = c.table_name
WHERE c.table_schema = lower(?)
  AND c.table_name = lower(?)
ORDER BY c.ordinal_position

SELECT tc.constraint_type, tc.constraint_name,
       kcu.column_name
FROM `{catalog}`.information_schema.table_constraints tc
JOIN `{catalog}`.information_schema.key_column_usage kcu
  ON tc.constraint_catalog = kcu.constraint_catalog
 AND tc.constraint_schema = kcu.constraint_schema
 AND tc.constraint_name = kcu.constraint_name
WHERE tc.table_schema = lower(?)
  AND tc.table_name = lower(?)
  AND tc.constraint_type IN ('PRIMARY KEY', 'UNIQUE')

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT pos AS __KUMO_BATCH__, col AS __KUMO_ID__
  FROM posexplode(from_json(?, 'array<bigint>'))
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, `ProductID`, `Name`, `ProductNumber`, `MakeFlag`, `FinishedGoodsFlag`, `SafetyStockLevel`, `ReorderPoint`, `StandardCost`, `ListPrice`, `Size`, `SizeUnitMeasureCode`, `WeightUnitMeasureCode`, `Weight`, `DaysToManufacture`, `ProductLine`, `Class`, `Style`, `ProductSubcategoryID`, `ProductModelID`, `SellStartDate`, `SellEndDate`, `DiscontinuedDate`, `ModifiedDate`
FROM TMP
JOIN `{catalog}`.`{schema}`.`adventureworks_products`
  ON `ProductID` = TMP.__KUMO_ID__

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT pos AS __KUMO_BATCH__, col.id AS __KUMO_ID__, col.e AS __KUMO_END_TIME__, col.s AS __KUMO_START_TIME__
  FROM posexplode(from_json(?, 'array<struct<id:bigint,e:string,s:string>>'))
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, `SalesOrderID`, `SalesOrderDetailID`, `CarrierTrackingNumber`, `OrderQty`, `ProductID`, `SpecialOfferID`, `UnitPrice`, `UnitPriceDiscount`, `LineTotal`, `ModifiedDate`, `CustomerID`, `OrderDate`
FROM TMP
JOIN `{catalog}`.`{schema}`.`adventureworks_sales_order_details`
  ON `ProductID` = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND `OrderDate` <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
 AND `OrderDate` > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
WHERE `OrderDate` <= ?
  AND `OrderDate` > ?
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
  PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__
  ORDER BY `OrderDate` DESC, `SalesOrderDetailID`
) <= 32
ORDER BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, `OrderDate` DESC, `SalesOrderDetailID`

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT pos AS __KUMO_BATCH__, col AS __KUMO_ID__
  FROM posexplode(from_json(?, 'array<bigint>'))
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, `CustomerID`, `PersonID`, `StoreID`, `TerritoryID`, `AccountNumber`, `ModifiedDate`
FROM TMP
JOIN `{catalog}`.`{schema}`.`adventureworks_customers`
  ON `CustomerID` = TMP.__KUMO_ID__

SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, `SalesOrderID`, `SalesOrderDetailID`, `CarrierTrackingNumber`, `OrderQty`, `ProductID`, `SpecialOfferID`, `UnitPrice`, `UnitPriceDiscount`, `LineTotal`, `ModifiedDate`, `CustomerID`, `OrderDate`
FROM TMP
JOIN `{catalog}`.`{schema}`.`adventureworks_sales_order_details`
  ON `ProductID` = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND `OrderDate` <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
 AND `OrderDate` > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
WHERE `OrderDate` <= ?
  AND `OrderDate` > ?
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
  PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__
  ORDER BY `OrderDate` DESC, `SalesOrderDetailID`
) <= 32
ORDER BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, `OrderDate` DESC, `SalesOrderDetailID`

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT pos AS __KUMO_BATCH__, col AS __KUMO_ID__
  FROM posexplode(from_json(?, 'array<bigint>'))
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, `CustomerID`, `PersonID`, `StoreID`, `TerritoryID`, `AccountNumber`, `ModifiedDate`
FROM TMP
JOIN `{catalog}`.`{schema}`.`adventureworks_customers`
  ON `CustomerID` = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
